scope: Standalone offline PDF experiment; reuse same-page printed tie cutouts with matching actual digit widths and independent anchor positions
priority: Practice timing: beat placement, duration, rests and tied continuation before techniques
limitations: Repeated regression corpus, not a blind test
Automatic pairing does not prove identical editions
Best reference track chosen only for evaluation
Rhythm diagnostics ignore pitch and chord size and do not replace full core validation
Techniques, repeats, tempo changes, grace placement, timbre and audible playback excluded
rhythm_method: Exact voice-0 beat durations, grace flags and attack/hold/rest presence with confirmed meter and validation. Ignores pitch and chord size; does not establish tempo, repeats, grace placement or audible timing.
